reviews.text: I am disappointed and upset. We took our dogs there, and I found one of the ladies pulling my dog's hair horribly and pulling the brush on him. They hurt his ears and made a cut that we didn't tell them about. My dogs came out trembling; they were scared.

I took my dog to be groomed. I asked how much for the service. The attendant told me $65.00 after I told her that my dog weighed about 40lbs. She stated that treatment for fleas would be a little extra. I said okay and told her how I wanted my dog trimmed. I waited for my dog, as we walked to the shop.
I saw the groomer punch my dog in the face, my stomach churned. I knew in that moment that I would never come back to this place. After the groomer realized that I saw what she was doing her speech towards my dog changed. When it came time to pay she charged me $120. I feel like she got all she could because she also knew that I would never come back. The heavens saw what happened. Karma is real.
I had never been to this store, I the service. I rate this store with A service ☺️
Took my dog Rusty to get his nails trimmed, had a great experience there.
Bought 2 Pied Cockatiels. Good deal. Would have liked some type of life warrantee but he pronised hia birds were healthy. I tiok him at his word. My mom is over the moon with her birds.

What can I even say.... let's see; the cockatiels were quite overweight. Bearded dragon was overweight and in too small of a tank, there were bags of fish on the ground. The budgie was alone. A few of the very large fish were in way too small of tanks. It was honestly really depressing to see the level of neglect. I understand some places get very overwhelmed with having so many different types of animals, but my advice would be.. stop filling your shop up!! Only get as many pets as you guys can handle to take care of. I've seen better pet care at PetCo and that's saying something.
